subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What should the Feishu card-action payload contract be for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` before the linked fix lands?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable fix changes the synthetic message content agents parse, so the repository needs an explicit owner decision on structured JSON versus command-text behavior.

options.title: Adopt structured pass-through
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after it preserves sibling action fields at the parser boundary, documents the JSON payload shape in tests, and proves a real Feishu form/select callback.

options.title: Fold into broader card parsing
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41609 the canonical design item and transfer this issue's concrete form/select field evidence there before closing this issue later.

options.title: Defer general pass-through
options.body: Keep only the current button/value path and close the form/select field pass-through request as not planned if maintainers do not want agents parsing raw Feishu card payloads.

recommendation.title: Adopt structured pass-through
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after it preserves sibling action fields at the parser boundary, documents the JSON payload shape in tests, and proves a real Feishu form/select callback.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the structured Feishu card-action path where this payload contract now belongs.
